g.text: Components are in-process modules, not independently deployed services.
Feature-to-feature arrows show service/rule dependencies; the deposits/streaks cycle is real.
Web routing and repository access are aggregated to avoid repeating an edge for every controller/repository.
Scheduled task classes reside in their respective feature packages; grouped here by runtime role.
Clock is injected into time-sensitive services and jobs; those repeated edges are omitted.
Purple = scheduling / time / development controls. Development controls require the dev profile.
DTO details, startup migrations/seeding and individual entity/repository classes are omitted.
